column1: # Source: src/core/Config.ts ENEMIES. speed is a multiplier of tuning enemy_speed.
# behaviour (16 Oct, depth plan item 4; numbers in tuning.tsv): - = none; bomber = blows up when it gets
#   within bomber_fuse of you (hurts you and enemies in bomber_blast_radius; killing it blasts enemies only);
#   healer = heals enemies near it every healer_every s; splitter = becomes split_count runners when killed;
#   shield = a shield of shield_hp (grows with distance like hp) soaks bullet hits; splash, lightning and burns
